---

## Hello! 👋

I'm Zhelin, an Environmental Studies student at UC Santa Barbara with a passion for data science, ecology, and exotic reptiles. I use R and Quarto to analyze environmental data, and outside of class I run a small reptile hobby studio focused on leachianus geckos and other lizards.

I have research experience in inorganic silica synthesis at Yongjiang Laboratory and marine science at UCSB's Oceanography Lab.
